topik.nama: 1. Grammar: Past Continuous and Past Simple

soalan.s: I ______ my homework when the lights went out.
soalan.h: Past continuous for a longer action interrupted by a short one.

soalan.s: While we ______ along the beach, we saw a turtle.

soalan.h: An action in progress at a time in the past.

a.x: Last December, twenty students from SMK Seri Pantai spent a weekend at a turtle sanctuary in Terengganu. On the first night, they were walking along the beach when they saw a green turtle crawling out of the sea. The ranger told them to keep their torches off because bright light confuses turtles. The students watched quietly as she dug a nest and laid nearly a hundred eggs. The next morning, they helped the rangers move the eggs to a protected hatchery, where they will stay for about fifty days. Before leaving, the students promised to reduce their use of plastic bags, which turtles often mistake for jellyfish.

b.t: Passage B: Email from Mei Ling
b.x: Dear Sara, I have just finished my first week at the new school and I'm already feeling at home. The teachers are friendly, although the Maths teacher gives a lot of homework! I have joined the robotics club, which meets every Wednesday. If we win the state competition in May, we will go to Kuala Lumpur for the finals. I haven't made many friends yet, but my deskmate, Priya, has been very kind. How is everyone back in Kuching? Please write soon. Love, Mei Ling

c.x: In March, the school's environment club started a recycling challenge. Each class had to collect paper, plastic and aluminium cans for four weeks. The class that collected the most would win a trip to the national park. Form 2 Bestari got off to a slow start because many students forgot to bring their recyclables. Their class monitor, Haziq, decided to put three coloured bins at the back of the class and made a chart to record the weight every Friday. By the third week, Bestari had overtaken every other class. In the end, the whole school collected 1.2 tonnes of waste, which was sold to a recycling centre. The money was used to buy plants for the school garden.

d.x: NOTICE — SCHOOL LIBRARY. The library will be closed from 3 to 7 June for renovation. During this period, books may be returned at the main office. Students who need to borrow books for their projects should do so before 2 June. The new library will have a reading corner, ten computers and a quiet study room. We apologise for any inconvenience. — Puan Rosnah, Head Librarian
